[PALTOWN Development Foundation] | Full Stack Developer - HIPAA Project | Remote | Contract $35-50K

Cancer patient support and education nonprofit needs experienced full-stack dev for meaningful 10-12 week contract.

PROJECT: Build secure, mobile-friendly front-end for Airtable database with SSO integration (Hivebrite), (potentially) HIPAA-compliant AWS hosting with BAA, and PDF export functionality.

STACK: Your recommendation (we prefer React/Vue + Node.js/Python, AWS with HIPAA compliance)

REQUIREMENTS: * HIPAA-compliant app development experience * SSO/IdP implementation * AWS with Business Associate Agreement setup * Airtable API integration * Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders

SCALE: Small, includes de-identified patient information, straightforward data interface

WHY IT MATTERS: Help cancer patients find treatment options that could extend their lives.

Details here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z8fWTmDHJndBDH11sz8_707B...
